title: Future: photo album profile over jmap-graph + FileNode
description: Re-scoped 2026-10-20 (Mark). No standalone photo spec: albums are Graphs (nodes link to FileNodes via uri = jmap:filenode:..., order via sort-key annotation, cover via annotation), sharing via RFC 9670 shareWith, tags as annotations; EXIF reading, gallery UI and face/object detection are implementation. The only interop gap is a shared annotation-key vocabulary so different photo apps agree (cover, order, date taken, location, tags) - i.e. a jmap-graph profile. Blocked on the 'no profiles yet' decision; revisit when profiles are allowed. Open question then: whether servers extract EXIF into annotations for graph-search, or leave it to FileNode metadata upstream.
